notes.title: Quality of Life & Balancing
notes.content:
[h1][b]Quality of Life Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a Tutorial, teaching the basics of the game
[*] Improved Tooltips and how they are displayed during deck building
[*] Improved Path Building, making it more intuitive and easier to build
[*] Added a Guest Warning every time a guest appears in a wave
[*] Added a UI Screen showcasing every Intruder and guest appearing before a wave
[*] Improved UI when placing a Room. Now the shop hides when placing a room, and tiles highlight properly, showcasing where you can place a Room
[*] Improved Hand UI when placing a Trap. Now you can hold trap cards that you don't have enough mana to play, and it highlights where they can be placed
[*] Added a universal option to click OR drag and drop in all actions
[*] Removed duplicate options when picking a card reward
[/list]

[h1][b]Balancing[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Recycling is now free, but you can only do it to traps placed on the castle. You can't recycle cards in your hand anymore
[*] Traps don't stay between waves anymore. They break at the end of each wave
[*] Barricade cards had a rework. Now, they only take one damage per hit, and their HP is related to their durability. Now, they are affected by the Torture Room Synergy
[*] Medium and Hard difficult rebalancing. Tier 2 enemies were too difficult to deal with, and they appeared in large quantities. So, they had their movement speed and health reduced, and waves were also re-structured a bit to be more fair for players to beat
[*] Reworked freeze mechanic to apply freeze stacks more consistently
[/list]

[b][h1]Bugfixing[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Greenhouse synergy wasn't adding mana
[*] Fixed a bug where Treasure synergy wasn't affecting the gold earned by the player
[*] Fixed a bug where traps that give mana would give way more mana than intended
[*] Fixed a bug where stun traps wouldn't work properly on the last room before the Party
[*] Fixed a bug where multi-tile traps wouldn't affect the room placed
[*] Fixed a bug where demons weren't dancing properly in the party
[*] Fixed a bug where doppelganger rooms were free
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life changes
notes.content:
Improvements to the Synergy UI
- Now the UI shows at all times how many points you have into a synergy.
- Synergies are always showing in the UI, making it easier to know the effect of each one.
- Now, rooms in a path show what synergy they have.

Placing rooms
- Added a 'breath" effect to rooms on the board when placing a new room, adding clarity to where you can place.

notes.title: QoL & Balancing
notes.content:
[b]Quality of Life[/b]
- After some community feedback, we made small changes to the placement of our UI. This way, it should feel more intuitive when you have new cards and can edit your deck. 

[b]Balancing[/b]
- Enemies deal less damage overall, giving players more room to play.
- Mana cost was updated for several cards, making them cheaper to use.
- Guests have more health, giving players more opportunities to keep them alive til they reach the Party.
- Waves have more downtime between enemy spawns, giving players time to prepare and build mana.
- Rewards given by completing waves should feel better overall
- Re-Roll cost reduced from 25 to 20.

notes.title: Bugfix and Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Bugfix:[/b]
- Solved a bug where 'Continue' wouldn't load a save file properly.
- Solved a bug where mana would regen exponentially faster after each wave.
- Solved a bug where the Castle Path would get stuck and impossible to edit.
- Solved a bug where the EndScreen music wouldn't stop playing after going back to the menu.

[b]Clarity and Improvements:[/b]
- Added a placeholder button that rebuilds the path to avoid any situation where it would get stuck.
- Updated empty tiles sprite to better communicate that it's possible to add rooms to them.
- Updated Tooltip collider to avoid overlapping.
- Fixed Synergy tooltip texts.

[b]Balancing:[/b]
- New Mana Regen reward values after bugfix.
- Re-roll cost reduced.
- Small adjustments to Torture cards.
